title: Data-Efficient Scaling-Law Discovery for Recommendation Systems via Coupled Hyperparameter Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.05643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale ranking and recommendation models of Web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do, and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in form. Yet ranking models have heterogeneous architectures which makes their scaling law less straightforward than that of LLMs. We address how to discover the scaling law of an arbitrary ranking model efficiently. We introduce a scaling layer, which groups primitive architecture parameters into semantically coherent groups and defines how they co-vary, inducing a mapping from a low-dimensional space of hyper-hyperparameters into the full architecture space. On top of it, Axia fits scaling-informed surrogates, selects configurations by a posterior-based acquisition criterion, and returns a Pareto frontier from which per-model operating points are validated -- replacing exhaustive sweeps with a small number of informative runs. translated_title: 通过耦合超参数缩放实现推荐系统数据高效的缩放定律发现
translated_abstract: 大型Web平台的排序与推荐模型与大语言模型类似，同样受益于计算量的增加，其缩放行为大致呈幂律形式。然而，排序模型具有异构架构，这使得其缩放定律的确定比大语言模型更为复杂。我们研究如何高效地发现任意排序模型的缩放定律。我们引入了一个缩放层，它将底层的架构参数划分为语义上连贯的组，并定义这些组之间如何协同变化，从而建立起从低维“超超参数”空间到完整架构空间的映射。在此基础上，Axia拟合缩放感知的代理模型，基于后验的采集准则选择配置，并返回帕累托前沿，从中验证每个模型的具体工作点——用少量信息量丰富的实验取代穷举式扫描。一个面向模型集群的评估协议
tldr: 该论文提出通过缩放层将低维超超参数映射到完整架构空间，并结合缩放感知代理模型与帕累托前沿选择，仅需少量实验即可高效发现任意推荐排序模型的缩放定律。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a scaling layer that maps low-dimensional hyper-hyperparameters to the full architecture space, combined with scaling-informed surrogates and Pareto frontier selection, enabling data-efficient discovery of scaling laws for arbitrary recommendation ranking models with only a few informative runs.
